crossRefs.note: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all…
What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?
To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might…
to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I…
Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting…
But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin?…
For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.
for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,
For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation…

translations.web: What then? Shall we sin, because we are not under law, but under grace? May it never be!
translations.bsb: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law, but under grace? Certainly not!
translations.kjv: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.
translations.asv: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under law, but under grace? God forbid.
